source: Standard GitHub merge-commit subject — must always pass even without a spec citation, because the cited work lives in the merged PR's commits.

input.commit_message:
Merge pull request #157 from ed-mays/feat/harness-cold-reader

feat(harness): MVP step 5 — cold-reader prompt + input-prep + eval scaffold

notes: Merge commits are always exempt. The body still mentions the merged feature but the linter MUST recognize the 'Merge ' subject prefix and exempt without requiring a citation. Catches any future regression that drops the merge exemption (e.g., from over-tightening conventional-commit enforcement).
